page.overview:
What is Anchor Street?

Anchor Street was a long thoroughfare in the Low City of Bral.

Anchor Street began at one of the ends of Dock Street and eventually ended upon Grand Street, along one of Low City's boundary points with Middle City, across from the Great Market. Along the way it was intersected by the ends of several streets. Eel Street, Hull Street, Sailmaker Street, Shipwright Street, and both ends of Round Street.

Along the span of buildings between Round Street's two ends, Anchor Street ran along the barrio known as Dracon-town. Additionally, two unnamed pathways descended from it, down to the Shipyards of the Rock.
